Nothing qualifies. A row enters this list only when the venue's own sheet or page explicitly says one entry / no rebuy / no add-on. Q1 describes the single question that would change this.

no event on any official Strip sheet states single-entry-only play, so nothing qualifies yet

Sorted by guarantee ÷ total entry fee (screening only). “Pool per entry” is what the sheet says reaches the prize pool, so two events with different fee splits stay comparable. Rows flagged ⚑ structure sheet ambiguous share an event number with another sheet (different starting flights) and are never ranked off a fee split they may not belong to.

Sources behind these rows, by room: 94 Venetian series rows read from the DSE IV calendar and its 38 linked structure sheets; 148 dated Wynn rows read from the venue's WPT structure booklet (one row per printed play day, fee split and re-entry rule beside it) and 4 undated Wynn rows from the daily poster; 3 Bellagio rows and 4 Caesars Palace rows, all recurring slates whose documents print no calendar date, so none of them is dated on this page. Rows whose own sheet prices a re-entry or add-on sit in the third tab regardless of room, which is where most of the Bellagio and Caesars rows are; the counts here cover every tab. Anything the sheet does not print is blank, and the row says which field is missing.

2026-12-18Friday · 2:00 PM $600 Milestone Satellite to $5,000 Seniors NLH (the “Tournament”) is a single day No Limit Hold’em event. This event will be held on the following day(s): • Friday, December 18, 2026 at 2 p.m. Must be 50 years of age or older to participate.
